title:
Staff at Blue Pits Housing Action , Newbarn Ltd and Freehold Cottage have today been trained in Crisis Prevention Institute 

CPI (Crisis Prevention Institute) training equips individuals with the skills to manage challenging behaviors, especially in high-stress environments like healthcare and education. It focuses on preventing and de-escalating crisis situations through verbal and non-verbal techniques, promoting safety for both staff and those they support. Training includes recognizing early warning signs, using de-escalation strategies, and, when necessary, employing safe and appropriate physical interventions.
